ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t43

ddl_steps.name: create sequence
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE t43.seq START WITH 10 INCREMENT BY 5 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 1000 CACHE 20 CYCLE

ddl_steps.name: alter sequence restart
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SEQUENCE t43.seq RESTART WITH 100

ddl_steps.name: alter sequence options
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SEQUENCE t43.seq INCREMENT BY 2 NO MAXVALUE NO CYCLE

ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SEQUENCE t43.seq RENAME TO seq2; ALTER SEQUENCE t43.seq2 SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: setval
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT setval('public.seq2', 500)

ddl_steps.name: drop sequence
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SEQUENCE IF EXISTS public.seq2 CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: statistics fixture
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t43.stat_t (a int, b int, c text); INSERT INTO t43.stat_t SELECT i, i*2, 'x' FROM generate_series(1,100) i

ddl_steps.name: create statistics
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE STATISTICS t43.st (dependencies, ndistinct) ON a, b FROM t43.stat_t

ddl_steps.name: create statistics if not exists
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE STATISTICS IF NOT EXISTS t43.st ON a, b FROM t43.stat_t

ddl_steps.name: alter statistics rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER STATISTICS t43.st RENAME TO st2

ddl_steps.name: alter statistics set target
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER STATISTICS t43.st2 SET STATISTICS 500

ddl_steps.name: drop statistics
ddl_steps.sql: DROP STATISTICS IF EXISTS t43.st2

ddl_steps.name: create extension
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements

ddl_steps.name: create extension schema/version
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE EXTENSION hstore SCHEMA t43

ddl_steps.name: alter extension update
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER EXTENSION hstore UPDATE

ddl_steps.name: alter extension set schema
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER EXTENSION hstore SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: alter extension add member
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER EXTENSION hstore ADD TABLE t43.t

ddl_steps.name: drop extension
ddl_steps.sql: DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS hstore, pg_stat_statements CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: drop schema
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t43 CASCADE
